name: MACD crossover
idea: A signal when the MACD line crosses its signal line on a closed bar; optionally only on the matching side of the zero line. The idea has ended on the opposite cross.

params.label: Fast average
params.help: Bars in the fast average of the MACD line.

params.label: Slow average
params.help: Bars in the slow average of the MACD line: more than the fast one.

params.label: Signal line
params.help: Bars in the average of the MACD line that makes the signal line.

params.label: Zero-line filter
params.help: Only signal when the MACD line is above zero (bullish) or below zero (bearish).

params.label: Swing size
params.help: Which swings count: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history.

constraints.message: The fast average must have fewer bars than the slow one.
